I implemented the LRU cache in `src/lru/main.clj`. It uses Java's built-in `LinkedHashMap` in access order, so every command runs in O(1) expected time. All 5 example cases pass with `node check.mjs`.

- **Build:** `build.sh` compiles the code ahead of time and packs it, with the Clojure runtime, into one jar at `target/lru.jar`. `./app` is a small launcher script that runs that jar with `java`.
- **Speed:** a 1,000,000-command input with capacity 1,000,000 took about 0.9 s, and one with c
